notes: The seed knowledge base the offline evaluation runs against, one entry per file in eval/corpus/.

The text files are authored the way a college's documents are: headings, paragraphs and tables. `harness.load_corpus` parses them into the same ExtractedDocument the PDF, DOCX and TXT extractors produce, so the real cleaner and the real heading-aware chunker run over them and the chunk boundaries, section breadcrumbs and page numbers in the evaluation are the ones the product would produce.
`category` and `department` are the columns the admin upload form fills. `department` is what the fallback message names, so it has to be a real office name.

The corpus is small and deliberately so: it is a fixture, not a knowledge base. It is large enough that a question has to actually retrieve the right passage rather than being handed it, and small enough that a person can read all of it and check every expected answer by eye.
